positions.name: CalibrationGroundedInReferencePlateVerification
positions.frame: what warrants the claim that the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration holds — bare assertion of a settled state, or verification against an external reference standard?
positions.why: All three expressions converge on the same warrant: the calibration figure (88.4 MHz) is not simply declared but anchored to verification against the June reference plates. src-1 states this in prose ('We verified the calibration against the June reference plates and it holds across the full observing band'); src-2 and src-3 restate the same instrument/calibration/verification content in compressed field-label form. The directional read spans register (prose vs. structured label) but holds the same reference-standard warrant throughout — no tension, just the same claim performed twice in different registers.
